French: We’re Going to Win Michigan, New Hampshire and Maine
videos.description: Lauren French, Senate Majority PAC senior advisor, says the PAC is making spending decisions week by week after pulling out of North Carolina and is looking closely at races in Kansas, South Carolina and Mississippi. French says Democrats may not be able to match Republican spending, but says Democratic candidates are outraising Republicans. French says that the October surprise will be if polling has been accurate or not and believes that Democrats will win Michigan, New Hampshire and Maine. She speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: GOP, Dems Pull Back Spending From North Carolina Senate Race
videos.description: Republican Representative Brad Knott of North Carolina said Michael Whatley, the GOP nominee for Senate, is running against a "very tough" Democratic candidate but expects him to 'close the gap.'
